source_rules.规则: 可开关并拖拽排序；多个打开只播最高匹配动画

source_evidence.quote:
1. Once you've set an Entry Animation and enter a stream room, everyone in the room including the streamer will see the animation.
2. You can toggle each Entry Animation off and on.
3. Press and hold to drag and drop Entry Animations in your preferred order.
4. If you've toggled on multiple Entry Animations, the animation highest on the list will be shown when you enter stream rooms.

For example if your Entry Animations are ordered with Army at the top, followed by Guardian and then Premium, the following will happen:
1. If you enter a stream room and you subscribe to that streamer's Army, the Army Entry Animation will play.
2. If you enter a stream room and you do not subscribe to that streamer's Army, but you are their Guardian, the Guardian Entry Animation will play.
3. If you enter a stream room and you are not a member of the streamer's Army nor their Guardian, the Premium Entry Animation will play.
